notes: Amendment-4b model card (e4a-scanner-card-build-1.1.0; statistics by e4a-scanner-card-1.0.0, 2026-10-17). Measured from the scans (median over 5 authorized development scans, plan §9; consumed development data, light statistics only; status per field in FIELD_STATUS, some are bounds): point_spacing_mm, noise_sigma_mm, duplicate_skin_offset_mm, duplicate_skin_fraction, edge_flare_mm, edge_flare_probability, outlier_fraction. Scans: 15651004_01.ply (03395097cd96), 28870000_A_FULL_SCAN.ply (38091ac91d9d), 23553000_B_FULL_SCAN 1.ply (6eba02723d4b), 38172000_01_SCAN_1.ply (07062eee17aa), 10839000_01_full_scan.ply (71cf0b216f43). Retained E2 ASSUMED values (not identifiable from an exported merged mesh without sensor poses): noise_incidence_gain, edge_erosion_probability, depth_jump_mm, grazing_start_deg, grazing_cutoff_deg, specular_cone_deg, specular_dropout_probability, random_dropout_probability, outlier_range_mm, duplicate_skin_rotation_deg, duplicate_skin_patch_mm, view_jitter_mm, triangulation_angle_deg, working_distance_mm; amendment 4b also asks for grazing and specular dropout, so this card is PARTIAL until those are measured (raw per-view exports or sensor poses) or the owner waives them. noise_sigma_mm is the 2 mm same-skin noise floor of the exports; the 5 mm / 10 mm patch residuals (median 0.0058 / 0.0063 mm) are close to the 2 mm floor (no large-scale waviness beyond white noise). duplicate_skin_offset_mm is an UPPER BOUND (skin-separation spread also holds the sheet thickness tolerance). edge_flare_mm and edge_flare_probability are LOWER BOUNDS: only flares up to 1 mm beyond the skins are measurable, and 0%-54% of the edge samples per scan were excluded because the wall continues into another surface. Evidence: docs/production/ENGINE_EVAL.md (block 'json scanner-card-evidence').
